title: Beam border
description: A single point of light travels the edge of a card. The beam is the core color — the one accent, in motion.
usage: For the one card on the page that deserves attention — a featured plan, a key upgrade. If two beams are visible at once, both stop working.
a11y: Pure decoration: the card's content carries all meaning. The animation is removed under prefers-reduced-motion; in browsers without @property the border rests, still complete.
